ground_truth.title: Farmers Market of Bluffton
ground_truth.main_content:
Farmers Market of Bluffton

Thursday, January 27, 2022

Date: January 27, 2022

Time: 12:00 PM - 5:00 PM

Address: 71 Green Street, Bluffton, SC 29910

The market is located around Martin Family Park in beautiful historic, downtown Bluffton. We feature seasonal fresh, local produce, plants, honey, eggs, beef, and seafood along with specialty items and prepared foods to include, BBQ, Pastas, Organic Meats, Crepes, Baked Goods and Pastries. On Thursday's The Farmers Market of Bluffton is a Must!
